Overview - Mangalayatan University - Aligarh
p ISO 9001:2015 Certified
h1 University Overview
p To be a leader in education, an institution must be founded on two basic principles: keeping the interest of students as its foremost priority and recognizing that knowledge is ever-growing, omnipresent and requires the opening of minds.
p At Mangalayatan University, we take pride in these two qualities being at the core of our existence. Mangalayatan (translated as the germinal bed of positive thought) aims to perpetuate a culture of hardwork, embracing change and preparing oneself for the fast progressing world with the latest skills and the highest level of social and personal values. Situated 20 km from the Yamuna Expressway in Uttar Pradesh, Mangalayatan University was founded in 2006 and has graduated over 7000+ students. Nearly 3500+ students from India and abroad are currently studying on campus.
p Mangalayatan University vision is to give students from all kinds of background, a quality educational experience leading to legitimately rewarding career opportunities.

p The Mangalayatan University is surrounded by rural communities and situated in Brij Kshetra, the birth place of Lord Krishna. The University is accessible by good communication facilities. To be a leader in education, an institution must be founded on two basic principles: keeping the interest of students as its foremost priority and recognizing that knowledge is ever-growing, omnipresent and requires the opening of minds.
p At Mangalayatan University, we take pride in these two qualities being at the core of our existence. Mangalayatan (translated as the germinal bed of positive thought) aims to perpetuate a culture of hardwork, embracing change and preparing oneself for the fast progressing world with the latest skills and the highest level of social and personal values.
p Situated 20 km from the Yamuna Expressway in Uttar Pradesh, Mangalayatan University was founded in 2006 and has graduated over 4000 students. Nearly 3500 students are currently studying on campus.

--- schema all ---
CREATE TABLE streams (
    id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    slug  TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    name  TEXT NOT NULL,
    intro TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq);
CREATE TABLE books (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    title       TEXT NOT NULL,
    author      TEXT,
    url         TEXT,
    description TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE institutes (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    city        TEXT,
    website     TEXT,
    description TEXT
, source_id TEXT, district TEXT, state TEXT, institution_type TEXT, institution_type_source_url TEXT, institution_type_confidence TEXT, institution_type_notes TEXT, institution_type_verified_at TEXT);
CREATE TABLE job_sectors (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE node_books (
    node_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES career_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    book_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES books(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (node_id, book_id)
);
CREATE TABLE node_institutes (
    node_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES career_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    institute_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES institutes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (node_id, institute_id)
);
CREATE TABLE node_job_sectors (
    node_id       INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES career_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    job_sector_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES job_sectors(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (node_id, job_sector_id)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "career_nodes" (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    slug      TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    stream_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES streams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    parent_id INTEGER REFERENCES "career_nodes"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    name      TEXT NOT NULL,
    intro     TEXT
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_books_title ON books(title);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_institutes_name ON institutes(name);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_job_sectors_name ON job_sectors(name);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_institutes_source_id
            ON institutes(source_id)
            WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_institutes_location
            ON institutes(state, district, city);
CREATE TABLE institute_courses (
            id                  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            source_id           TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
            institute_id        INTEGER NOT NULL
                                    REFERENCES institutes(id)
                                    ON DELETE CASCADE,
            name                TEXT NOT NULL,
            level               TEXT NOT NULL,
            credential          TEXT,
            specialization      TEXT,
            duration            TEXT,
            mode                TEXT,
            eligibility         TEXT,
            official_course_url TEXT NOT NULL,
            verification_status TEXT NOT NULL
        , mapping_gap TEXT);
CREATE INDEX idx_institute_courses_institute
            ON institute_courses(institute_id);
CREATE TABLE course_career_nodes (
            course_id      INTEGER NOT NULL
                               REFERENCES institute_courses(id)
                               ON DELETE CASCADE,
            node_id        INTEGER NOT NULL
                               REFERENCES career_nodes(id)
                               ON DELETE CASCADE,
            relation       TEXT NOT NULL,
            confidence     TEXT NOT NULL,
            mapping_status TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (course_id, node_id)
        );
CREATE INDEX idx_course_career_nodes_node
            ON course_career_nodes(node_id);
CREATE TABLE institute_categories (
            institute_id INTEGER NOT NULL
                             REFERENCES institutes(id)
                             ON DELETE CASCADE,
            category     TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (institute_id, category)
        );
CREATE TABLE institute_rankings (
            institute_id      INTEGER NOT NULL
                                  REFERENCES institutes(id)
                                  ON DELETE CASCADE,
            system            TEXT NOT NULL,
            year              INTEGER NOT NULL,
            category          TEXT NOT NULL,
            nirf_institute_id TEXT,
            rank              INTEGER,
            rank_band         TEXT,
            score             REAL,
            source_url        TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (institute_id, system, year, category)
        );
CREATE INDEX idx_institute_rankings_order
            ON institute_rankings(year, category, rank, rank_band);
CREATE INDEX idx_institutes_type
            ON institutes(institution_type);

The Ph.D. program offered by Mangalayatan University, Aligarh, is carefully planned to promote intellectual development through a disciplined research environment. The university provides access to state-of-the-art research facilities, a helpful academic environment, and knowledgeable guidance. Students are urged to conduct high-calibre research that respects academic integrity and creativity while tackling pressing issues in the real world.

Doctorate of Philosophy (Ph.D) Programs Offered by Mangalayatan University Aligarh

Agriculture Economics Law Physics
Biotechnology Education Library & Information Science Physical Education
Botany Electrical Engineering Management Political Science
Chemistry Electronics & Communication Engineering Mathematics Psychology
Civil Engineering English Mechanical Engineering Public Administration
Commerce Fine Arts (Visual & Performing Arts / Painting) Microbiology Sociology
Computer Application Hindi Nursing Tourism & Hotel Management
Computer Science & Engineering History Pharmacy Zoology
Journalism & Mass Communication Jain Philosophy

Ph.D. Admission Eligibility Criteria (As per UGC norms)

To apply for the Ph.D. program at Mangalayatan University, candidates must meet the following criteria:

  • Master's degree with at least 55% marks (5% relaxation for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/Differently-Abled).
  • 4-year Bachelor's degree holders after implementation of NEP 2020 must have a minimum of 75% marks.
  • M.Phil. holders and UGC-NET/CSIR-NET/GATE qualified candidates are exempted from the entrance exam but must appear for the interview.
  • Foreign nationals must have a valid research visa and necessary government approvals. The university should be enlisted in AIU and subject equivalency certificate should be avail for the same.

Ph.D. Course Duration as per UGC norms.(Full-Time & Part-Time)

  • Full-Time Ph.D.: Minimum 3 years and Maximum 8 years for male and 10 years for female with extension approval including coursework, research, and thesis submission.
  • Part-Time Ph.D. Minimum 3 years and Maximum 8 years for male and 10 years for female with extension approval including coursework, research, and thesis submission.
Note - Duration is as per UGC guidelines and may vary based on research progress.

Career Opportunities After a Doctorate (PhD) Program

A doctorate in philosophy (Ph.D.) is a highly esteemed academic credential that provides access to advanced career pathways in industry, research, academia, policymaking, and other fields. Scholars with a Ph.D. possess research abilities, critical thinking, and in-depth topic knowledge that are highly sought after in a variety of industries.

This professional degree not only equips you with expertise in a specialised area but also establishes you as a potent contender for the job. It is an opportunity for continuous learning and intellectual fulfilment. Ph.D programs can pave the way for various other international fellowships and grants.

  1. Academia and University Teaching
  2. Research and Development (R&D) - Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Engineering, IT.
  3. Policy Think Tanks and Research Institutes
  4. Corporate Sector (R&D, Strategy, Analytics)
  5. International Organisations and NGOs
